On 10 October 2024, 3 people clashed with the road police in the village of Ilovlya (Ilovlinskiy, Volgograd). The incident happened when the road police attempted to detain an alleged drunk driver from the local Roma community. During the road stop, the driver and 2 of other members of Roma community began to interfere with the arrest and attacked the police. Tensions between Roma, other locals and police in the village have been ongoing since August and the incident most likely took place in the context of this conflict.

On 6 October 2024, police arrested 4 participants of the food distribution campaign for the homeless in Yekaterinburg (Ekaterinburg, Sverdlovsk). The event was not only humanitarian in nature. The organizers, associated with the Confederation of Anarchists of Yekaterinburg, hung posters in support of political measures to help the homeless.

On 10 October 2024, in a likely attempt to assassinate, an unidentified individual shot at a former deputy head of the Republic of Ingushetia in Lapino (Odintsovskiy, Moscow Oblast). The man survived, but was hospitalized with serious injuries. Back in 2007, the victim was the subject of a criminal case opened against him in Chechnya, as announced by the head of Chechnya, Ramzan Kadyrov. The assassination attempt is likely a part of the reemerging conflict between Chechnya and Ingushetia.

Around 6 October 2024 (as reported), police detained more than 150 people, including migrants, during raids on 2 markets in St. Petersburg (Admiralteyskiy, Saint Petersburg). The detained were sent to the military enlistment and registration facility, where, according to the Investigative Committee around 100 individuals expressed a 'desire to enlist in the military on the contract base'.

People came to the administration building, demanding a solution to the problem of homeless animals in the village. The specific reason for the gathering was an attack by a pack of stray dogs on a child.
